Commentary.Commentary: We are back.  The openers have to lay the foundation, Mahmudul Hasan Joy and Zakir Hasan to open for the hosts. A heavy roller is being used on the pitch. We could see more turn now on this track. It's Vishwa Fernando with the new red-cherry though. Two slips and a gully.
...THE CHASE...

Bangladesh need a good start. Less than hours of play remaining before Lunch and Bangladesh will hope not to lose any wickets. The visitors though will look to make some early inroads. Their bowlers are fresh. They bundled out Bangladesh in around two sessions. Can Bangladesh show some character and snatch a result from this game? Let's find out.

Sri Lanka cross the 500- runs mark and says that's enough. More than enough you think. It wasn't a great batting performance from the visitors but the likes of Nishan Madushka, Angelo Mathews and Prabath Jayasuriya chipped in with runs to add to their first innings score. Sri Lanka will be confident at this stage. On the flip side, Bangladesh are on course of losing a home series. Still early to say but they have to bring something special to chase this down. Time is not an issue but the form of a couple of their batters will be tested again.

Commentary.Commentary: All in readiness for the game to begin as the two umpires make their way out to the middle. Sri Lanka have a commanding lead of 455 runs and they will extend it today. Prabath Jayasuriya and Angelo Mathews will continue their partnership. Bangladesh needs to clinch those 4 wickets early today, not allowing the batters to score quickly. Khaled Ahmed has the ball in hand and will begin the proceedings for Bangladesh. Let's go...

Despite an impressive show from Bangladesh with the ball, Lanka are well ahead in this game. The visitors will be hoping the lower order can hang around for sometime and take the lead over 500. Bangladesh on the other hand, will look to carry forward the momentum they had on Day 3 and hope to put up another good show. The first session is an important one. Stay tuned.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

Their bowlers did a fine job in the third session by picking six but Lanka's lead is over 450. They'll want to stretch it over 500. Bangladesh on the other hand, will want to keep it below that. The only positive for them is if they manage to get the remaining wickets quickly, they have a lot of time to score the runs needed. Sri Lanka on the other hand, will be very confident in the position they're. Do join us for Day 4. Until next time, goodbye and take care!

A spirited bowling effort from Bangladesh but they're still well behind in the game and that is because of their poor batting effort earlier on. They were bundled out for a very low score courtesy some brilliant bowling by the Lankans pacers. That saw them conceding a massive lead of over 350.
